story_zh: 我叫李明，今年十岁。我的爸爸是老师，妈妈在公司工作。我家有一只漂亮的猫。在学校，我认识了一个新朋友。她叫王丽，是我的同学。我们开始一起学习汉字，打篮球，唱歌。她懂我的名字，我也懂她的姓。我们比谁学得快。
story_pinyin: Wǒ jiào Lǐ Míng, jīnnián shí suì. Wǒ de bàba shì lǎoshī, māma zài gōngsī gōngzuò. Wǒ jiā yǒu yī zhī piàoliang de māo. Zài xuéxiào, wǒ rènshíle yīgè xīn péngyǒu. Tā jiào Wáng Lì, shì wǒ de tóngxué. Wǒmen kāishǐ yīqǐ xuéxí hànzì, dǎ lánqiú, chànggē. Tā dǒng wǒ de míngzì, wǒ yě dǒng tā de xìng. Wǒmen bǐ shéi xué dé kuài.
story_en: My name is Li Ming, I am ten years old. My dad is a teacher, my mom works at a company. My family has a beautiful cat. At school, I met a new friend. Her name is Wang Li, she is my classmate. We started learning Chinese characters together, playing basketball, and singing. She understands my name, and I understand her surname. We compare who learns faster.
